notes.title: We have released Mercury Race, a racing-shooting game!
notes.notes:
Hello fighters,

we have released [b]Mercury Race[/b], a retrofuturistic racing-shooting game.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/817530/Mercury_Race/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24679369/9f8e2aca6d555f6f72196c4243e1808297a3d75a.jpg[/img][/url]

If you like racing games take a look at it!

Cheers!

notes.title: Super Blue Fighter 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello fighters,

we have removed the old leaderboard and integrated the Steam official one.

The old leaderboard was hacked by a reptilian corporation (play [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/461760/]Reptilian Rebellion[/url] for a better understanding of reptilian entities) so we have lost all previous rankings.

So, let´s start again, who is going to be the best Super Blue Fighter EVER???

Thank you for playing the game!

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.notes:
We have just upload a small maintenance update:
-The leaderboard works again.
-Slow motion makes time to run faster, so the more you use it the less time you have to clear the stage. 
This was the normal behaviour in the original game, but it was broken in the last update.

We are working on new games, but we want to add some content to our little boy, Super Blue Fighter, so a new update will come soon.

Bye!


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24679369/ba068c2e430058d713b71eef3e50ca757937a17a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Super Blue Fighter Updated
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24679369/3b9a5ff877038b6b0ab3df485d329052d37770e9.gif[/img]
Super Blue Fighter has just been updated.
Version 1.0.6 includes new content:

-[b]New Harlequin Robot:[/b] Changes the green/red robots to the valid color.
-[b]New Multi Shot Robot:[/b] Shots 10 shots around him.
-[b]Bouncing Shot Item:[/b] This shot bounces with walls and defeats all robots ii finds on its way.
-New sound effects and light changes on some sprites.

We think the game gains some speed and pinball-ish feeling, we hope you like it. More content will be added soon, feel free to propose any idea about new robots or items. We appreciate it.

Álvaro Herrero
